llm_fields.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to traditional artisans of the Vishwakarma community in Karnataka to help them purchase modern tools and upgrade their technological skills.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicant must belong to the Vishwakarma community, be a permanent resident of Karnataka, be aged 18 to 55 years, be engaged in a traditional Vishwakarma occupation (such as gold & silver work, sculpture, blacksmith, woodwork & handicrafts, or metallurgy), and must not have availed any loan facility from KVCDC in previous years.
